resources.string: Temporarily switch to a saved profile based on the battery, the charger or the time of day. Rules never copy a profile.
Uses the selected profile when the battery is at or below the threshold.
Battery level does not change the profile.
Uses the selected profile while the charger is connected.
Charging does not change the profile.
Uses the selected profile inside the window, including across midnight.
The time of day does not change the profile.
